correctness.rationale: The Picard exact sequence identifies J(K) with NS(Y)/T. Ten pair fibers and a seven-component central fiber give rank(T)=18 and center determinant 16; two pencil blowups give rho(Y)=rho(X)+2. The discriminant line is a generic section of type-A4 braid arrangement, hence its monodromy contains pure five-strand braid monodromy. The four adjacent squared Picard--Lefschetz transvections form a unimodular test and force every torsion invariant to satisfy 2w=0. Six rational Weierstrass points yield all 16 two-torsion points. An exact checker corroborated the determinant and mod-2 through mod-12 fixed-space assertions.

value.rationale: Determines a natural Jacobian Mordell--Weil group on every no-three-lines six-line double-plane pencil with distinct node directions, including Noether--Lefschetz specializations; provides uniform torsion rigidity and exact free-rank jumps. This extends genuinely beyond the already-known generic case and supplies arithmetic information for the genus-two Abel--Jacobi problem.
